preconditions: Dedicated alpha Worker identity and exact deployed SHA are retained.
Bridge runtime cohort includes only the approved teen fixture.
Teen and parent preview builds use the same exact approved repository head.
Live Supabase migration, grant, RLS, RPC, and policy parity is recorded.
No real teen journal, mood, media, name, contact, or family content is used.
Rollback and kill-switch owners are present.
Founder approval is recorded before account creation, live writes, deletion, or credential use.

steps: Teen creates or receives the controlled parent-link flow.
Parent redeems the exact invite.
Both sides observe active relationship state.
Unrelated user cannot read the relationship.
Teen revokes or unlinks the relationship.
Parent access ends immediately.
Re-link or re-share requires a new explicit action.
Teen selects one synthetic Journal entry and one synthetic Mood check-in.
Teen sees the summary-only notice before submission.
Goal and Scrapbook selections are rejected before request creation.
Allowlisted teen creates one Bridge request.
Worker authenticates the teen and generates a validated summary or labeled fallback.
Parent reads themes, conversation starters, limitations, timestamps, and fallback state only.
Parent cannot query the raw Journal or Mood source.
Unrelated user cannot query the request, summary, view record, or source.
Teen revokes the share.
Parent and unrelated user are denied after revocation.
Teen may explicitly re-share through a new valid lifecycle.
Teen and one accepted Crew member establish the approved connection state.
Teen creates one synthetic check-in shared with that member.
Recipient sees only the shared active check-in.
Unrelated user and pending, blocked, removed, or revoked actors are denied.
Recipient sends one preset encouragement.
Duplicate, invalid, or unauthorized encouragement behavior is observed.
Owner revokes the exact active share and receives an observed-row success.
A repeated or unmatched revoke returns failure rather than false success.
Recipient loses feed access immediately after revocation.

journeys.approvalGate: Founder approval is required before destructive processing of the controlled fixture.
steps: Teen requests deletion and observes the seven-day grace state.
Cancellation is tested before destructive processing.
A fresh request is created for the approved destructive probe.
The trusted processor is invoked through an approved path after the grace condition is satisfied in the test environment.
Private storage under the teen owner prefix is removed.
Auth identity is removed.
Owned rows cascade or are explicitly removed.
Parent Bridge and relationship access ends.
Crew identity retention is removed or anonymized as designed.
A hashed deletion receipt remains without private content.
Retry or replay does not restore content or create duplicate destructive work.
Orphan inventory returns zero.
requiredEvidence: storage bucket inventory and object counts

journeys.approvalGate: Founder approval is required before destructive processing of the controlled fixture.
steps: Parent requests and completes the approved deletion probe.
Parent Auth identity and parent-owned records are removed.
Teen-private Journal, Mood, Pages, and unrelated content remain intact.
Parent relationship and summary access ends.
No raw teen content is copied into receipts, logs, or retained artifacts.
Sign out or delete the first controlled user as applicable.
Clear approved local caches through the product flow.
Sign in as the unrelated controlled user on the same device or browser context.
Confirm no first-user Pages, moods, Bridge state, Crew state, media, notifications, or cached identity is visible.
Restart or restore the app and repeat the isolation check.

stopConditions: Any parent or unrelated actor receives raw teen content.
Any revoked, blocked, removed, pending, deleted, or unrelated actor retains private access.
The app claims a revoke or deletion that cannot be observed in the authoritative state.
The runtime cohort is wider than the approved fixture list.
Private content appears in logs, screenshots, reports, notifications, or receipts.
Deletion leaves restorable or orphaned private data.
Production routing or public availability changes.
nonClaims: This file contains no account identifier, credential, private content, or executed journey result.
Planned steps do not prove live RLS, deletion, revocation, isolation, or device behavior.
